per_candidate.id: s2:A Pulsar-Inspired Timing Framework for Power System: Optimization and Performanc

rationale: Paper 2206.00427 directly investigates the performance of search techniques in the presence of red noise, providing evidence on how the Fast Folding Algorithm (FFA) compares to the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) in such conditions. This contributes substantive new evidence on part of the question.
